# RadioMaster

> RadioMaster is free, open-source (MIT) radio automation software for Windows, macOS and Linux, made by DovaFM Digital Entertainment Group. It runs a radio station from one screen: playlist tabs with live start times, hour markers, smart crossfades, advert and jingle scheduling, a playlist generator, an event scheduler, a cart wall, microphone ducking, voice tracking, text to speech, Icecast/Shoutcast streaming (MP3, AAC, Opus, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC) and AzuraCast station management. RadioMaster Server is a headless version for Linux and Windows Server that the desktop app controls with File → Connect to Server.

RadioMaster is an independent project and is not affiliated with RadioBOSS, SAM Broadcaster, ZaraRadio or AzuraCast. There is no account, subscription or paid edition.

## Pages

- [RadioMaster home](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/): features, screenshots, downloads and FAQ
- [RadioMaster Server](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/server/): headless radio automation for Linux and Windows Server, setup and connecting from the desktop app
- [RadioMaster Server documentation](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/server/docs/): install, options, data folder, systemd and Windows services, HTTPS and built-in Let's Encrypt, the web portal, Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx/Caddy/IIS reverse proxies, security and troubleshooting
- [How to start an internet radio station for free](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/start-an-internet-radio-station/): step-by-step guide
- [All guides](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/)
- [Stream to Icecast or Shoutcast](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/stream-to-icecast-shoutcast/): encoders, formats, bitrates, ffmpeg and AzuraCast DJ ports
- [Use the playlist generator](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/playlist-generator/): categories, templates, patterns, timed inserts and auto-playlist
- [Schedule adverts and jingles](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/advertisement-scheduler/): rules by songs, minutes or set times, run dates and proof of play
- [Automate with the event scheduler](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/event-scheduler/): timed actions and station commands
- [Set up users and permissions](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/users-and-permissions/)
- [Present a live show](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/live-shows/): microphone, cart wall, voice tracks, text to speech and shortcuts
- [Manage an AzuraCast station](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/azuracast/): API key, queue, requests, media and DJs
- [Broadcast from anywhere](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/broadcast-from-anywhere/): RadioMaster Server, Connect to Server and the web portal
- [Make a plugin](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/plugins/): plugin.json, events, RM: commands and the remote control API
- [Updates](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/updates/): release notes for every version
